source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), two renders of the same CLS-B rudder: a small one upper right and a larger one lower left (seen from the pilot's side, front left, slightly from above; housing in the middle, a pedal plate on each side)
mappingSource: catalog brunner.json (Quick install guide V2 https://shop.brunner-simulation.ch/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/20260204_BRUNNER_QuickInstallGuide_CLS-B_Rudder_V2.pdf): Z axis = yaw, X rotation = left brake, Y rotation = right brake
note: Markers are on the larger lower-left render. Left/right follow from the viewing direction (the pedal plate faces point toward the camera, so the photo-left plate is the pilot's left pedal). Toe brakes are marked on the upper (toe) part of each plate; the rudder on top of the housing.
